primary_endpoint: test AUC, AD vs NC, model ENS(LogReg+XGB+GB) on 817 ncRNAs + age, sex, APOE4, detect_rate

models.ENS(LogReg+XGB+GB): average probability of 3 pipelines, each tuned by 5-fold GridSearchCV on full training split (BIG_GRIDS, k in [100, 300, all])
models.Panel10+clinical: LogReg C=1 on top-10 ncRNAs from notebook 03 + covariates
models.Clinical+quality: LogReg C=1 on age, sex, APOE4, detect_rate (baseline A2)
models.Clinical: LogReg C=1 on age, sex, APOE4 (baseline A)

thresholds: chosen on 5-fold training OOF predictions; rules: 'accuracy' and 'balanced'
